verdict.rationale: End-to-end testing integration is a fair axis for a UI framework and its tooling, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official E2E tool or a dev-server-integrated test setup. The `sv add` docs say it adds 'new functionality' without naming any testing integration, and one community comment notes the absence of a clear testing story. Missing for 10: any evidence of official E2E testing tooling or dev-server integration.
